description: Real people answer an everyday question from their own life and region. Done by the community: several anonymous humans answer through the Human Registry app – fast, remote, directional. Every task is reviewed by a human before it goes out. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot; acting for a business: price on request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

question.description: The question, e.g. 'How do you greet strangers when entering a small shop?'

name: request_local_knowledge
title: Ask locals an everyday question
